en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a rustic stone building built into a hillside, with a man standing in the doorway and another seated on a bench outside. The structure appears to be a spring house along a forested mountain path, surrounded by dense conifer trees. On the right side, there is a blank light area for writing, printed with red text identifying the place and the publisher, plus a handwritten date.
